name: Bug Report

title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug

---

**Describe the Bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Command or Code Invoked**
Provide the exact CLI command or Python code used to reproduce the issue:
```bash
dopplergps run --adsb ... --audio ...
```

**Traceback / Error Output**
```text
Paste error log or traceback here
```

**Environment & Setup**
 - OS: [e.g. Ubuntu 22.04, macOS 14.4, Windows 11]
 - Python Version: [e.g. 3.10.12, 3.12.2]
 - DopplerGPS Version: [e.g. 0.1.0 or git commit SHA]
 - Audio Format & Sample Rate: [e.g. 44.1kHz stereo .wav]
 - ADS-B Source: [e.g. OpenSky Network, ADS-B Exchange, FlightAware]

**Expected Behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. spectrogram quality, aircraft types).
